resources.string: We use your learning data to personalize recommendations and feedback.

By using StudySync, you understand that we may collect and store learning interaction data (for example: quiz results, time spent studying, and selected topics) to improve your experience with personalized recommendations and analytics-driven prompts.\n\nIf you decline, you can still use the app in limited mode, but personalization and analytics-driven prompts will be disabled.
Help us tailor your study experience.
